texts.zh:
欢迎光临雪拉企业！

我们是在[trader_system.GetName]恒星系对外运营的商业联合企业，主营贸易——我们雪拉企业坚信，贸易是文明的基石。

如果您想进行贸易的话，请联系我们，我们会尽量满足您的一切需要。
texts.en:
Welcome to XuraCorp!

We are a business conglomerate operating out of the [trader_system.GetName] system, specializing in trade - the very building blocks of civilization, as we like to say here at XuraCorp.

Please, do not hesitate to contact us if you're interested in making a good deal.

texts.zh:
我是里甘商业交易所的代表。我们以[trader_system.GetName]的空间站为基地，负责帮助各个团体建立完善的贸易渠道以达千年。

如果您手头有多余的资源想要出售，找我们就对了，我们提供的价格保证让您满意。
texts.en:
I speak on behalf of the Riggan Commerce Exchange. We have facilitated trade negotiations between interested parties on our station in the [trader_system.GetName] system for more than a thousand of your years.

If you happen to possess more resources than you need, we are more than willing to take it off your hands. You will be duly compensated, of course.

texts.zh:
很高兴见到你们，朋友们！我代表穆塔根商人公会欢迎你们来到[trader_system.GetName]恒星系。我们公会由数百位独立的穆塔根商船舰长组成，他们勇敢地在太空中探索，寻找商机。

您可以在我们的机构中出售多余的资源。如果您有意出售，请随时联系我们。
texts.en:
Well met, friends! I represent the Muutagan Merchant Guild, and let me be the first to welcome you to the [trader_system.GetName] system. Our organization consists of hundreds of independent Muutagan merchant captains who brave the spaceways in search of the next good deal.

At our facilities, you will be able to trade away some of your excess resources. Please contact us if you are interested in such an arrangement.
